extension.summary: Watch F1 live streams and race replays in Kodi (Android build)
extension.description: LIVE F1/motorsport streams from daddylive (race, qualifying, practice as they happen), plus FULL RACE REPLAYS from a GitHub replay-catalog — ok.ru direct MP4 (the .ru streams as 2nd option; Dailymotion stripped 2026-11-02). Pure-Python stdlib only, no bundled Windows binaries.
extension.disclaimer: This addon scrapes publicly available streaming links. The author does not host or stream any content. For educational use only.
extension.s: v2.8.18 - REPLAYS ARE BACK ON ANDROID: replays were silently hidden since the 2.8.13 platform split even though the catalog module shipped in every zip — the backend gate now self-dispatches (Windows+exe → live fullraces scrape; everything else → GitHub replay-catalog via ok.ru, pure stdlib). Menu, search and playback all live on the phone. v2.8.14 - DIAG: resolve failures toast the exact failing STEP (STEP1 watch.php / STEP2 stream page / STEP3 embed hosts / STEP4 edge manifest). Resolve retries once (2s) before failing. Wider embed fallbacks: +dembed.st, +bembed.sbs. fetch_page timeout 20s->25s.
extension.news: v2.8.17 - REPLAY LOOKUP: race pages outside catalog coverage no longer fall through to a live fullraces.com scrape that Cloudflare-403s on phones — the catalog (raw.githubusercontent, cached) is Android's source of truth and near-miss URL variants (scheme/query/case/slash) now match. Same code as PC 2.8.20. Also v2.8.16 - BACKUP LANES: +3 English channels from the same proven dlive family (verified resolving 2026-11-02): Sky Main Event UK (race simulcast), Sky Sports Mix UK, SuperSport Motorsport ZA (Sky's F1 world feed, English). All ride the existing resolver+proxy chain. Same code as PC 2.8.19. v2.8.18 - REPLAYS ON ANDROID: backend gate now self-dispatches — GitHub replay-catalog (ok.ru direct MP4, the .ru streams) serves replays, search and playback on Android; Windows+exe keeps the live fullraces scrape. main.py is byte-identical on both tracks from this version. v2.8.12 - DIAG2: "Server nexa unreachable" toasts now include the real reason (DNS fail / timeout / SSL error) from f1_servers.http_error() — phone-side cause is visible without a log. v2.8.11 - DIAG: on a failed resolve, the toast now shows the exact failing STEP (STEP1 watch.php / STEP2 stream page / STEP3 embed hosts / STEP4 edge manifest) so phone-side failures are self-reported. Resolve retries once after 2s. Wider embed fallbacks: +dembed.st (observed live 2026-11-02), +bembed.sbs. v2.8.10 - ANDROID TRACK: first platform-split release. Live lanes only (dlive.sx + vertex/nexa/kora numbered servers) — replays omitted, that upstream blocks non-browser clients. Same live resolver as PC track; updates ride their own version line so PC-side changes can't break the phone. (PC track continues at plugin.video.f1streams.)
